SIG-MULTI.definition: Both channels identical sum of sine tones 100, 1000 and 6000 Hz, each peak amplitude 0.1; initial phase 0.

SIG-STEREO.definition: Left sine 440 Hz peak 0.25, right sine 3000 Hz peak 0.125; initial phase 0.

SIG-440.definition: Both channels sine 440 Hz peak 0.25; phase 0.

SIG-PULSE.definition: Both channels sine 1000 Hz peak 0.25 gated on for first 100 ms of each second, otherwise zero; no edge ramp.
